youtube_title: Cracked Heels In Winter? Fix It At Night | Body Fix #38 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #38. Winter's here, and your heels have CRACKS like dry land? They hurt too?
B is right. Thick cream at night + COTTON SOCKS.
Dry skin + pressure + open footwear = deeper cracks.
Fix: Cream after bath, gentle pumice, NEVER blades, closed-back footwear.
Red flags: Bleeding, infected cracks, or you have diabetes? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
